title: Röra sig i naturen
request: Accurately identified Finnish forest path or natural landscape; no claim that every visible area allows all activities.

title: Kultur och lagstiftning
request: Distinct verified Finnish nature-access setting; no fabricated legal sign or statute.

title: Du får
request: Pictorial overview of the following source-permitted activities, without adding permissions.

title: Till fots, skidor eller cykel
request: Actual walking, skiing or cycling in a natural setting, accurately identified; the exact source lists all three.

title: Tillfälligt tälta
request: Licensed wilderness tent photograph used illustratively; no invented distance in metres or assertion about site-specific camping permission.

title: Naturbär och svampar
request: Accurately identified ordinary wild berry or mushroom; no identification, edibility or protected-status advice added.

title: Meta och pimpla
request: Angling or ice-fishing equipment/activity; retain the source exception about some waters, no invented legal map.

title: Båt, simning och is
request: Distinct accurately identified Finnish water-recreation scene; no claim that photographed ice is safe.

title: Du får inte
request: Clear prohibition overview limited to the following source list.

title: Inte störa
request: Quiet home/environment relationship; no accusation that real photographed people caused disturbance.

title: Gårdar och odlade åkrar
request: Private-yard or cultivated-field context with an illustrative prohibition overlay, not evidence of actual trespass.

title: Skydda djur och fågelbon
request: Actual bird/nest photograph with species identity verified; no sensitive new nest-location information or disturbance instructions.

title: Växande träd
request: Distinct live tree photograph with a no-damage pictogram; no assertion of an actual offence.

title: Träd, ris, mossa och lav
request: Accurately identified fallen wood, moss or lichen with an illustrative no-collection symbol; no new species/protection rule.

title: Öppen eld
request: Controlled campfire photograph with a source-context prohibition overlay; not a claim that the photographed fire was unlawful.

title: Hemfrid och tält
request: Qualitative tent/nearby home and noise relationship, no invented distance threshold.

title: Inte skräpa ner
request: Visible litter objects with a no-litter symbol; no identified person blamed.

title: Motorfordon i terrängen
request: Actual off-road vehicle photograph with an illustrative prohibition mark, not an allegation of an actual violation.

title: Hund kopplad i tätort
request: Leashed dog in a public urban setting, no invented local place claim.

title: Mars till augusti
request: Exact source March–August interval, bird breeding and leash symbols; no new dates or exceptions.

title: Lekplatser och badstränder
request: Dog, playground and public-beach symbols show the exact source prohibition, no fabricated municipal sign.
